scientific_integrity: The classification of subalgebras and the Gaussian coefficient identity are prior mathematical inputs; the pair-incidence sum and its limiting dimensions are the claim assessed here. Independent audit is not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the standard filiform Lie algebra with a regular nilpotent one-block action and dimension at least four is treated.
Pairwise vector-sum closure is counted, not full orbit types, dimension-by-dimension pair incidence, or arbitrary filiform families.
Structural classification of subalgebras is known from the general almost-Abelian theory.
Historical priority and mathematical correctness have not been independently validated.
title: Subalgebra permutability of standard filiform Lie algebras over finite fields
